flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/vhub/{upload/jobs/VhubEndDayFileJob, upload/helpers/{VhubNoticeQueryHelper,VhubViolationCaseXmlBuilder}, download/{jobs/VhubDownloadJob,helpers/VhubDownloadHelper}}, crud/ocmsizdb/{vhubquery/VhubOffenceQueryRepository,ocmsoffencevhub/OcmsOffenceVhub}, framework/schedulers/VhubJobsScheduler, framework/services/comcrypt/helper/{ComcryptCallbackHelper,ComcryptWorkflowConfigResolver}, resources/{cron-schedules-prod,application-prod,sftp/sftp-common,sftp/sftp-prod}.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not part of the send/receive flow (only reports and triggers, see OCMS35.4)
note: The vHub interface is built in ocmsadminprivateapi: three crons (end-day 05:35, download 07:20, report 07:30, all enabled=true in prod) select foreign-vehicle PS-FOR notices, build the XML, hand it to COMCRYPT, record ocms_offence_vhub, then process ACK and NTL. Actual delivery to vHub through COMCRYPT and CFT SFTP cannot be proven from the repo, and the job reports success as soon as the file is staged in blob, so the send step is Sebagian. The NTL list from vHub is only stored as a file and shown in a report, not saved to the database, so Sebagian. The code also sends Settled and Cancelled statuses (wider than the story). One notice with an empty mandatory field fails the whole run (VhubNoticeQueryHelper.java:129-140). There is no vHub-specific maintenance ticket; OCMS-DF-2026-122 (foreign vehicle admin fee, Closed) touches the amount that is sent. Sheet status 'Requirement given - Gen flow'. The FOR parameter value, SFTP credentials and the vHub side: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claimable for selection, file building, tracking and ACK processing. Actual delivery to vHub and use of the NTL list need evidence from the environment (COMCRYPT/SFTP logs and real ACK files) before being treated as complete.

steps.step: OCMS selects foreign vehicle numbers that have outstanding parking offences
steps.detail: VhubEndDayFileJob calls querySettled, queryCancelled and queryOutstanding and merges them per notice (VhubEndDayFileJob.java:101-104). queryOutstanding selects notices with vehicle_registration_type = 'F' (foreign vehicle), suspension PS with epr_reason 'FOR', crs_reason not 'FP' (not fully paid), and notice_date_and_time at least FOR days ago per the PERIOD/FOR parameter in ocms_parameter (VhubOffenceQueryRepository.java:221-229). A notice already sent is re-sent only when its status changed, it was not acknowledged, or amount/location/description/vehicle number changed (lines 233-240); for example the $15 admin fee after 90 days (OCMS-DF-2026-122, Closed, Prod deployed). The code also sends Settled and Cancelled statuses (lines 39-131), so it is wider than the story, which only mentions outstanding. The FOR parameter value in the database: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS builds an XML file with the vehicle numbers and offence details
steps.detail: toViolationDetail fills ViolationReportNo (notice_no), VehicleRegistrationNumber with spaces removed (line 53), VehicleType (54-56), offence date and location (57-58), and an OffenceDetail with description, status O/S/C and fine amount (60-65). The PaymentDetails block is only for Settled and is skipped when there is no successful web transaction (69-80). Before the file is built, a notice with an empty location, offence_description, amount_payable or offence date fails the whole run (VhubNoticeQueryHelper.java:129-140): one incomplete notice holds back every other notice that day.

steps.step: OCMS sends the file to vHub
steps.detail: Cron cron.vhubupload.schedule=0 35 5 * * ? with enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:162-163) and sftp.enabled=true (application-prod.properties:82). The job splits into files of 10,000 records (vhub.endday.maxRecordsPerFile, sftp-common.properties:79) named URA_VIOLATION_CASE_yyyyMMdd_##.xml (VhubEndDayFileJob.java:120-137, 248-250), puts the plaintext file in Azure Blob (line 171), then requests a COMCRYPT token (181-182). Encryption and the SFTP upload to cftvhub are done by the COMCRYPT callback (ComcryptCallbackHelper.java:257-258), not by the job. If the token is null or fails, the job only logs a warning, continues, still stores the tracking rows and reports success (183-199), so 'success' means the file is staged, not delivered. The upload to vHub and receipt on the vHub side: cannot verify from repo. A notice that is not acknowledged is re-sent on the next run (step 5).

steps.step: OCMS records which notices were sent to vHub
steps.detail: After each file, storeTrackingRows saves one row per notice to ocms_offence_vhub: offence_no, offence date, location, description, vehicle_no, vehicle_type, amount_payable, vhub_status (O/S/C) and sent_vhub_datetime (VhubEndDayFileJob.java:252-271). These rows are used by the next queries to compare against what was last sent (VhubOffenceQueryRepository.java:12-23). If the insert fails, the job only logs a warning (197-199) and the notice is selected again on the next run.

steps.step: OCMS receives the vHub reply (ACK per notice) and updates the status
steps.detail: Cron cron.vhubdownload.schedule=0 20 7 * * ? enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:171-172). The job lists the cftvhub SFTP folder, picks files whose name contains VIOLATION_CASE_ACK or NTL, and requests a COMCRYPT decrypt token (VhubDownloadJob.java:71-75, 93-95); the callback decrypts and calls VhubDownloadHelper (ComcryptCallbackHelper.java:590-592). applyAck sets vhub_sftp_status_code '0' on success, or the error code and reason on failure, and skips rows that already have a code (VhubDownloadHelper.java:74-90). Rows without code '0' are selected again by the end-day query (VhubOffenceQueryRepository.java:239). One thing to watch: the SFTP file is deleted even when processing fails (ComcryptCallbackHelper.java:697-712), so an ACK that fails to process is lost and the notice is re-sent to vHub. Real ACK files from vHub: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS receives the vehicle records from vHub (NTL list) for vHub operations
steps.detail: The NTL file (URA_NTL_yyyyMMdd_##.xml) is decrypted and only stored as a file in Azure Blob (blob.folder.vhub.ntl, sftp-common.properties:73); the parser is only used to count rows (VhubDownloadHelper.java:103-122). There is no database table or follow-up action on the vehicles in the NTL. The only user is the EBRNTL sheet of the daily report, which loads the latest NTL file of the day, and if it cannot be read the sheet is left empty with only a warning log (VhubReportHelper.java:138-165, 314-354). The SFTP file is deleted even when staging fails (ComcryptCallbackHelper.java:711-712). NTL content and how vHub uses it: cannot verify from repo.
